mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_payment (payment_id, user_id, amount, status, point_applied, created_at) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{status}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id AS paymentId, user_id AS userId, amount, status, pg_transaction_id AS pgTransactionId, point_applied AS pointApplied, created_at AS createdAt, completed_at AS completedAt FROM point_payment WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE point_payment SET status = 'COMPLETED', point_applied = 1, pg_transaction_id = #{pgTransactionId}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
